definitionZh: 反递增的CSS属性可以用来通过指定值来增加或减少命名的CSS计数器的值,也可以用来防止所有计数器或个人计数器的值被改变.
sourceDefinition: The counter-increment CSS property can be used to increase or decrease the value of the named CSS counters by the specified values, or to prevent all counters or an individual counter's value from being changed.
